shared_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce two high-fidelity full-page mobile UI concept artboards side by side for Calgary Crocs, an underwater hockey club app, in an ORIGINAL adaptation of the Orb Social design language shown in the two reference images. Reference image 1 is the Orb white social-feed-card screen, reference image 2 is the dark soft-gradient messaging screen. Use these for visual style only, not exact layouts, user imagery, Orb logo, slogans, or web3/crypto/NFT features.
Landscape concept board with two LARGE straight-on complete mobile screens, nearly filling the canvas; a small unobtrusive page-pair label outside. No physical phone bezels, no perspective, mountainous marketing backdrop, explanation paragraphs or app-store advertising. Compact status bar optional. Make designs look like genuine contemporary social app pages, not dashboards. Consistent system across all screens: true near-black shell #0b0b0b; confident large rounded neo-grotesk titles, white on black; thick readable black text on generous bright-white large-radius cards; 32–40px corner radii; soft-gray pill controls; colorful rounded-square cover tiles; tasteful overlapping avatars; bold simple icons; vivid burnt-orange accent for primary actions or selected navigation. Small aquatic teal, mint and violet in club covers, not orange on every surface. Subtle warm coral-to-lilac glow at the top ONLY on messaging screens, translucent charcoal rounded conversation rows on that background. Other pages use white cards on black rather than a black glass panel dashboard.
Floating bottom navigation is one coherent compact bar with five large round icon buttons with small labels: Home, Schedule, Messages, Account, Club. The selected circle is vivid orange. Keep nav inside the screen safe area with sufficient bottom padding; it MUST NOT cover content or controls. No generic neon outlines, gold financial styling, condensed athletic mono type, technical panel grids, instrument dashboards or giant hero photographs. Personality comes from the friendly confident shapes, contrasting surfaces, colorful little covers and real club content. All UI text sharp, legible and correctly spelled. Uppercase avatar initials AR, SR, MR. Preserve green selected Yes / red selected No semantics, orange is only a brand/action accent. Touch-sized actions and plausible 390px mobile density.
Club-only fictional example data: Alex Rivera (You), Sam Rivera, Mila Rivera, coach Casey Morgan. Thursday training on THU 29 OCT, 7:45–9:30 PM, MNP Sport Centre. Friday hockey FRI 30 OCT, 8:30–9:30 PM. No money, tokens, wallets, follower counts, arbitrary charts, awards, gamified streaks, memberships-as-NFTs or invented features. No hockey sticks, malformed sporting equipment, highly detailed swimming anatomy or trademarked cartoon characters. Do not copy the reference's promotional chrome. No watermark.

sets.name: 11-orb-home-schedule
sets.pages:
Board label "11 / HOME + SCHEDULE".
LEFT Home: header "Your club", small brand "CALGARY CROCS", circular notification button and AR profile avatar. A short horizontal row of colorful rounded-square PROGRAM/CHANNEL navigation tiles labeled "General", "Club", "Youth"; these are navigation, not ephemeral stories, no story progress rings. Their cover art uses original simple abstract aquatic graphics, no NFT avatars. Main big bright WHITE rounded practice card: compact author-like header "Next practice", date tile "THU 29 OCT", strong linked title "Thursday training" with chevron, time and location. Within the card show compact attendance rows "You", "Sam", "Mila", each separate "Yes" and "No" buttons. You and Mila Yes selected green, Sam No selected soft red. Group small clearly clickable Attendance / Plan / Teams buttons together along the card bottom. Below, a white rounded social-style club-news card from "Casey Morgan · Club update", text "Welcome to the new season", small colorful abstract pool-cover thumbnail, a small reply/reaction row. Do not make attendance controls giant or hide them below fold. Bottom nav Home orange selected.
RIGHT Schedule: header "Schedule", small circular calendar export icon labeled "Export" and compact orange "New" button. One clean row with "Upcoming" selected and "Past", a small filter pill "All events" rather than multiple stacked toggle bars. Two or three bright white oversized rounded event cards on black, each has a compact date column, linked event title, time, location. Featured Thursday training repeats the SAME compact direct You/Sam/Mila Yes/No attendance pattern with green/red selected states and real Attendance / Plan / Teams buttons grouped together. Second smaller Friday hockey card shows its date/time and compact Your response Yes/No. End cards above floating nav, no clipping essential controls. Bottom nav Schedule orange selected. Both pages feel social, bold and lively like reference 1, not a minimal spreadsheet.

sets.name: 12-orb-messages-conversation
sets.pages:
Board label "12 / MESSAGES + CONVERSATION".
LEFT Messages: large "Messages" title, round compose button, AR avatar, understated coral/orange glow fading into plum then black in top quarter, just like the mood of reference image 2, NOT a full-screen opaque gradient. Slim search pill. Compact tabs "All" selected and "Unread". Rounded translucent charcoal conversation rows with colorful rounded-square cover art and original simple aquatic graphics. Row 1 "General", "Casey: Welcome to the new season!", "12:56", small warm-gradient unread badge "3", tiny pin marker. Row 2 "Thursday training", "Meet poolside 10 minutes early.", "11:00", unread badge "2". Row 3 "Youth", "Jamie: See you Thursday", "Yesterday". Row 4 "Alex & Casey", "Thanks for the feedback!", "Yesterday". These are club chats, not public creator feeds. Bold chat titles, clear secondary previews, personable covers. Bottom nav Messages orange selected; no floating extra + obscuring rows.
RIGHT Conversation: selected "Thursday training". Top bar back arrow, colorful rounded-square training cover, title with small "Event channel" subtitle, participant icon. One clearly distinct compact pinned strip "Poolside 10 minutes early" with pin icon, no more menu in strip. Date separator "Today". Show a few chat bubbles: Casey Morgan, white bubble on dark "Meet poolside 10 minutes early for a quick briefing."; Alex right-aligned muted mint/teal bubble "Sounds good — see you there!"; Sam white bubble "I'll bring the spare caps." White received bubbles with black text and comfortable modern rounded shapes. A tiny orange reaction chip with a simple thumbs-up and count "2" attached below one bubble, not overlapping message text. Persistent small reaction face affordance outside the text corner. Bottom composer rounded light-charcoal input "Write a message...", plus icon, microphone, orange circular send arrow. No global bottom nav inside the conversation, leave room for the keyboard/composer. No huge blank message area. Top glow remains very subtle. Familiar highly usable social messaging design, not an AI chatbot.

sets.name: 13-orb-progress-feedback
sets.pages:
Board label "13 / PROGRESS + FEEDBACK".
LEFT Account Progress: large header "Alex Rivera" with round AR avatar on black. Clear sibling tabs "Membership", "Progress" selected, "Feedback"; optional Attendance reachable by horizontal scroll but don't cram unreadable text. Big bright-white rounded current-goal card on black. Header "Current goal" and compact Edit button opposite. Bold goal "Create space after the pass". Accurate progress "3/6 check-ins" with clean pill progress bar exactly half filled; large but not enormous orange "Check in" button and quiet "Reflections" action beside it. Under it section header "Fitness tests" with "View all". One bright-white rounded surface with two COMPACT two-line test rows: "50 m swim" / "Best 1:30" on left, right-aligned "1:30" and green down arrow "0:03" beneath. Second "Pool lengths" / "Best 18" left, right-aligned "18" with green up arrow "2" beneath. Keep results aligned, NO repeated Latest captions. Optional small note "Updated 25 Oct" quiet. Bottom nav Account orange selected.
RIGHT Account Feedback: same header and SAME sibling tabs but Feedback selected. No nested modal or duplicate Feedback title. A white rounded reflection card "Your reflections", short copy "How did practice feel?", compact orange "Reflect" action at right. White rounded coach rating card with header "Coach ratings", a row "Thursday training", "29 Oct", bold "8/10" on right and a chevron. White rounded coach-note card with Casey's small avatar and bold "Casey Morgan", label "Coach note", body "Great support play. Keep moving after the pass.", small date, a quiet reaction affordance allowed. White rounded Videos card with compact original abstract teal pool-cover thumbnail, play button, title "Passing review", duration "2:14". All cards compact enough to browse, generous black gutters and small purposeful colored details like reference 1. No huge section-icon disks or pastel card soup. Bottom nav Account orange selected.
